description: Hello! We are Starlight Syndicate, a team of curious and motivated students interested in science, space and technology. We enjoy sharing ideas, learning new things and working together to solve real-world problems. Through NASA Space Apps Challenge, we want to connect space technology with agriculture in Tajikistan and create something meaningful and useful.
summary:
Our project, Adapting Farms with NASA Data, is a website designed to help farmers in Tajikistan better understand environmental conditions that affect agriculture. Agriculture depends on weather, water and soil conditions, but this information is not always easy to access or understand.

Our website includes a map of Tajikistan where users can select different regions and explore information such as rainfall, temperature and soil moisture. It also has sections about NASA data, soil and crops.

We created this project to connect space technology with everyday farming and make environmental information easier to understand. We hope it can help farmers learn more about local conditions and make better-informed decisions when planning their agricultural activities.
details:
1. What does the project do?

Our project, Adapting Farms with NASA Data, is a website designed to help farmers in Tajikistan understand environmental conditions that affect agriculture. It brings information about different regions together in one place and helps users explore conditions such as rainfall, temperature and soil moisture.

2. How does it work?

The website includes an interactive map of Tajikistan. Users can select different regions and explore the available environmental information. There are also separate sections about NASA data, soil and crops. This makes it easier to find and understand information related to farming.

3. What benefits does it have?

The website can help farmers learn more about the conditions in their areas. Information about rainfall, temperature and soil moisture can be useful when planning agricultural activities. It also helps make environmental information easier to understand and access.

4. What is the intended impact of the project?

We used Lovable, an AI-assisted platform, to build our website, create its different sections and work on its design. We also used ChatGPT as a supporting tool during our research and project development. It helped us understand information about NASA data and its connection to agriculture, organize large amounts of information into clear and useful points, and improve our written explanations. When we found several sources with a lot of information, ChatGPT helped us summarize the main ideas and explain them in a simpler way. It also helped us organize our thoughts and improve the structure of our project description. We reviewed the information and made the final decisions as a team. Our project is presented as a website that users can access online.

5. What tools, coding languages, hardware or software did you use?

We used Lovable, an AI-assisted platform, to build our website and create its different sections. We also used ChatGPT to help us with research, explanations, writing and organizing our ideas. Our project is presented as a website that users can access online.

6. How is your project creative? What factors did your team consider?

Our project is creative because it connects NASA space technology with agriculture in Tajikistan, a real issue that affects many people in our country. We wanted to create something useful and easy to understand. While developing our idea, we considered the needs of farmers, local weather conditions, water resources and the importance of soil. We also focused on making the website simple to navigate so that people can find the information they need.
